name: B. D. Industries (Pune) Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1984, B. D. Industries (Pune) 
Ltd manufactures and trades Plastic fuel tanks.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
BDIL began with the repair and manufacturing of traction batteries and later expanded into producing plastic container boxes using roto-moulding technology. The acquisition of Toyo Containers enabled the production of high-quality rotomolded battery boxes and water tanks. Over time, the company diversified into manufacturing plastic components for automotive and industrial sectors. Today, it is actively involved in the manufacturing and trading of plastic products across various industries.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 31.5%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
